profile.headline: Technical Lead at Profisee
profile.summary: A young, charismatic, professional looking to create a new path toward his main career goals in the IT field. Thrives in working with a group to solve critical problems and creating extensive solutions to meet the businesses or clients needs. Looking to grow within the company by rising to meet expectations within his position description while creating a pathway to explore new opportunities within the company. Previous experience included a number of customer service roles which allows for cooperation for clients and fellow colleagues alike.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer / IT Director
Web Developer
positions.description: Converting the current CREOL section of the UCF website to a more modern theme. Updating the current Microsoft SQL server and converting it to the integrated database. Creating new design implementations within the CREOL division of the website.

positions.title: Sales Associate / Remote Support Technician
positions.description:
Supervised new trainees and oversaw roles and procedures according to company policies.

Oversaw final preparations on site locations at new At&t location. 

Set up computer network and POS systems for new At&t location.

Oversaw Operational procedures at 3 different locations.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Website development in PHP, and JavaScript along with WordPress.  Creating automation tools that allow the end administrator to simultaneously work with newsletter, website and social media updates.

positions.title: Kitchen Manager
positions.description:
performed "back of house" duties along with managing staff in the restaurant. 

Received exemplary scores on maintenance monthly reports.  

Oversaw training and development of kitchen staff

positions.title: PCHO (Personal Computing Home Office)
positions.description: Sold computers and accessories to international and local consumers, while working very closely with the I.T. department (geek squad) to provide an excellent customer service experience.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: provided knowledge and information about all aspects of electronics ranging from cell phone plans and accessories to "do it yourself" hobby electronics.
